        RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
        RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
        RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
        RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
        RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
        RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
        EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
        EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
    } } }
            zg361_cl_m317_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = 1
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
        }

    if = {
        limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
			    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
			    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
			    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
			    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
			    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_state
			    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
			    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
			    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
			    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
			    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
			    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
			    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
			    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
			    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
			}

        }
        zg361_case_ah_advance_03_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_04_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            # A failed transition leaves the frozen stage retryable.
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_03_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        # A resource RED leaves the bounded case open and retries the same
        # frozen stage; it never skips the unpaid mechanism or mints a receipt.
        zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_03_effect = yes
    }
    }
}

zg361_cl_run_ah_stage_04_effect = {
    # Revalidate the frozen case and live authority even when every mechanism
    # receipt was written early and the core calls below will all be skipped.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            OR = {
                liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
                AND = {
                    # AH and AI cases open in parallel.  Once #319 really
                    # moves the subject, both frozen cases may finish only
                    # under this exact settled vacancy/title postcondition.
                    var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
                    var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 3
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 6
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
                    liege = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
                    primary_title = var:zg361_transfer_cl_title
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_title = { holder = this }
                }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 319 }
        zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_04_effect = yes
    }
    else = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_prompt_gate value = 0 }
    if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
        RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
        RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
        RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
        RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
        RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_state
        RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
        EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
        EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
    } } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_subject_response }
                zg361_cl_m319_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = var:zg361_cl_m319_subject_response
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { is_ai = yes }
                zg361_cl_m319_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = 1
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_prompt_pending = 1 }
                save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_prompt_gate value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_cl_prompt_gate = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_prompt_pending value = 1 }
                save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_prompt_gate value = 1 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.319 days = 1 }
            }
        }

    if = {
        limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
			    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
			    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
			    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
			    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
			    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_state
			    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
			    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
			}

        }
        zg361_case_ah_advance_04_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_05_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            # A failed transition leaves the frozen stage retryable.
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_04_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        # A resource RED leaves the bounded case open and retries the same
        # frozen stage; it never skips the unpaid mechanism or mints a receipt.
        zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_04_effect = yes
    }
    }
}
